messages:
maria (Support): Customer opened a ticket — invoice shows ~316 tokens for a single chat call but their SDK estimator reports ~270. They say dashboard also shows ~270. Can someone help triage?

alex (Billing): Can you paste request id / meter log? we can cross-check the billing pipeline.

maria (Support): Request id from customer: req-abc123. They provided a curl repro and SDK snippet. I'll paste minimal repro below.

maria (Support): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_XXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2x","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: long doc..."}],"stream":false}'
```

maria (Support): Customer copied server response headers: `X-Redwood-Tokens: 316` and billing-bot posted: 

meter-bot: Billing meter recorded 316 tokens for req-abc123 at 2024-11-03T15:22:10Z

sam (SDK): Quick note — our client estimator v1.2.1 tokenizes only the user+assistant messages by default and deliberately omits the system prompt and injected tool messages. If the platform adds a system preamble or sidecar tool output on the server, the estimator will undercount.

maria (Support): Customer insists they didn't send extra tool calls. They did see no function call in the JSON.

jon (Eng): Can you share the exact request payload the customer sent (we need to check whether an upstream sidecar inserted a system message or a hidden tool stream). Also, did they use streaming? streaming stops can change how clients accumulate tokens.

maria (Support): They said stream=false in the curl above. I'll ask for the full raw request/response pair.

alex (Billing): I pulled the meter record: req-abc123 -> billed_tokens:316, breakdown header: prompt: 124, completion: 192. Note: completion includes a 42-token tool-output entry recorded by the sidecar (internal_tool:summary).

sam (SDK): That matches the undercount pattern. SDK estimator omitted sidecar tool output (internal_tool) and also skipped the system prompt. That explains ~316 vs ~270 delta.

maria (Support): Customer is asking for a detailed explanation and possible credit. they're upset because their preflight estimates are used for quota controls.

jon (Eng): Root cause: private sidecar injected an internal tool result after model generation finished (we log as tool-output on server side). Billing counts that tool-output tokens as part of completion. SDK estimator doesn't know about server-injected tool tokens.

sam (SDK): Short term: add explicit note in SDK docs and a helper that can call /v1/usage/preflight to get server-side token projection (we have a route). Medium term: SDK v1.2.3 will include an optional flag estimate_include_system_and_tools=true to better reflect billed tokens.

alex (Billing): For this customer: propose credit for the 42 tokens (or prorated) because they relied on SDK estimates for quota. I'll draft credit and ping legal for precedent.

maria (Support): Customer accepted a partial credit and wants the technical explanation in writing. I'll send a summary: server-side sidecar tool output counted in completion; SDK estimate omitted that; streaming not involved.

jon (Eng): Filing internal bug: INF-4721 — surface server-injected tool tokens in usage docs + add server preflight endpoint link. ETA: docs patch + SDK helper in 2wk.

sam (SDK): I'll open the SDK PR for the helper and mark breaking changes in changelog.

maria (Support): Thanks all. I'll update the ticket and close after credit is applied. :thumbsup:

alex (Billing): Credit issued (txn: credit-2024-11-03-req-abc123). Noting in billing ledger.

meter-bot: Metering trace attached: https://internal.redwood/trace/req-abc123 — shows internal_tool:summary block contributing 42 tokens.

maria (Support): Closing loop with customer now.
